mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post ( course_id, user_id, title, content, likes_count, save_count, created_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content,jdbcType=CLOB}, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, course_id AS courseId, user_id AS userId, title, content, likes_count AS likesCount, save_count AS saveCount, created_at AS createdAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM post WHERE post_id = #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND deleted_at IS NULL
